patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-width dark backgrounds and white backgrounds, often featuring large, high-quality product or lifestyle imagery that sometimes bleeds to the edge.
Headings use a large, clean sans-serif font with generous letter spacing, creating a modern and sophisticated feel. Subheadings and labels often use uppercase text.
The primary color scheme is a high-contrast black and white, complemented by various shades of dark and light gray for backgrounds, text, and subtle accents, maintaining a minimalist aesthetic.

As the user scrolls, the initial hero video transitions to a different frame or state, revealing a 'Shop all' call-to-action. Simultaneously, the top announcement bar disappears, and a sticky navigation bar with the logo and menu items slides down into view.
Product feature sections frequently pair a large, compelling image on one side with concise, benefit-driven text on the other, often with the image extending to the screen edge.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a full-bleed video background with a large, centered text overlay. Upon scrolling, the video content subtly shifts or plays a different segment, and a primary call-to-action button fades in. Concurrently, the initial top-level announcement bar slides out of view, and a new, compact sticky navigation bar slides in from the top, providing persistent access to site navigation.

Content sections below the hero are revealed with a subtle scroll-triggered animation, typically a gentle fade-in combined with a slight upward translation, as they enter the viewport. This creates a dynamic and engaging browsing experience without being overly distracting.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) with clear, legible body text and smaller, often uppercase, labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and some image elements, but overall the design maintains sharp, clean edges for sections and containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous padding around content blocks and within the hero section, creating a sense of openness and premium feel.

standout: The site's standout feature is its sophisticated and understated presentation of high-end audio products. It masterfully blends aspirational lifestyle imagery with detailed product shots, using a minimalist color palette and refined typography to convey luxury and quality without overt flashiness. The interactive video hero and subtle scroll-triggered animations enhance this premium feel.
